'''Opal''' is a gem dropped by the {{MCW|Elder Guardian}}. It is used to buy [[Opal Earrings]] from the [[Jeweler]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Mob loot ===
An {{MCW|Elder Guardian}} always drops one opal when killed by a player.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/elder_guardian.json}}</ref>
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
=== Trading ===
{| class="wikitable"
! Villager !! Level !! Wants !! Gives
|-
| [[Jeweler]] || Novice || 4 × {{ItemLink|Obol}} + {{ItemLink|Opal}} || {{ItemLink|Opal Earrings}}
|-
| [[Jeweler]] || Master || {{ItemLink|Opal}} || 4 × {{ItemLink|Obol}}
|}
<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/toolsmith/5/sell_opal.json}}</ref>
An opal can either be turned into [[jewelry]] or sold back to a Master-level Jeweler for 4 [[Obol]]s.

== Advancements ==
Obtaining an opal grants ''Canto I'' ("Defeat the Sea God") in the [[Advancements/Tutorial|Tutorial]] tab, which rewards a [[Crystal Heart]]. It is the first of the four ''Canto'' advancements.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/obtain_opal.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Gems can now be sold to the Jeweler.}}
{{History line|1.12.3|Now built on a poisonous potato instead of a fermented spider eye, so it no longer counts as a fermented spider eye in recipes.}}
}}

== Trivia ==
* Like the other gems, opal is built on a poisonous potato; through 1.12.2 it was built on a fermented spider eye.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/item_modifier/opal.json}}</ref>
